target: 05 Technical architecture/Recovery Workbench API Specification v5/rwb-comms.yaml

fixes.new:
/notices/{noticeId}/channel-view:
    get:
      tags:
      - Litigation
      summary: Read the channel view of a notice
      operationId: getNoticesNoticeidChannelView
      x-module: P6
      x-owner: "P6"
      x-capability:
        area: Litigation
        right: R
      parameters:
      - name: noticeId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
          format: uuid
      - name: channel
        in: query
        required: true
        schema:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/NoticeChannel'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Success
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/NoticeChannelView'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/E401'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/E403'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/E404'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/E409'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/E422'
        '503':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/E503'
components:
  securitySchemes:

          type: string

          description: Success

            application/json:

/notices/{noticeId}/responses:
    get:
      tags:
      - Litigation
      summary: List the responses to the notice, newest first
      operationId: getNoticesNoticeidResponses
      x-module: P6
      x-owner: "P6"
      x-capability:
        area: Litigation
        right: R
      parameters:
      - name: noticeId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
          format: uuid
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Success
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Response'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/E401'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/E403'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/E404'
        '503':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/E503'
